title: Choose the visual world for brickbot.ro (round 8)
question: The motto leads every hero, followed by a plain line: we qualified for the FIRST Championship 2026. Sketches are richer this time but still rough; depth and motion arrive in the build. The deal put Live Rail first.

options.label: Live Rail
options.lineage: reference-edition pages: twin columns around a fixed centre rail of keys
options.thesis: Two columns, the students and this season, twinned around a live yellow rail down the middle of every page; the rail's keys are the navigation.
options.viewport: The wordmark at left and 'We build our future brick by brick.' at right, split by the rail. Below: The students (drive team photo, what they run) and The 2025–26 season (Nationals photo, 'We qualified for the FIRST Championship 2026'). Rail keys: Team · 2026 · Partner · Join.
options.risk: Symmetry is calm; it gets its energy from the rail and the photos, so they must be big and the current must move.

raised.raise: Each part of the team speaks in its own sign voice where it appears.
The chosen state is drawn solid and the others stay dashed: one committed line, never a toggle chip.
States print themselves as text (e.g. 'next event: …') rather than appearing as badges.

options.label: Event Night
options.lineage: night-market lantern streets, recast as a competition hall after dark
options.thesis: A string of yellow lights over the wordmark and motto, and below them a row of stalls: drive team, workshop, schools, Worlds 2026, each under its own painted sign.
options.viewport: Bulbs swing above the centred wordmark and motto, with a plain line underneath; four signed photo stalls fill the lower half.
options.case: Warm, crowded and human, with real energy. Less electric-engineered, and the glow sits close to neon.
options.risk: Can feel like a festival rather than an engineering team.

options.label: Pattern Envelope
options.thesis: Robot parts as tissue pattern pieces.
options.case: Declined: off-brand manila and no people.
options.kept: Chosen state solid, the rest dashed.

options.label: Riso System
options.case: Declined: near-duplicate of the Two-Ink Issue you passed on.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.case: Declined: hacker neon, the cliché you ruled out.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark team site with the wordmark, the motto and a yellow accent, built to the level of team254.com.
canonCard.viewport: The team photo with the wordmark, the motto and two buttons.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other strong team's site.
